title: Counterfactual Invariance to Spurious Correlations: Why and How to Pass Stress Tests

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness by swapping positive and negative sentiment adjectives in Amazon product reviews to test if models spuriously rely on sentiment to predict review helpfulness or product categories.
Measuring worst-group accuracy on the MNLI dataset to evaluate how models rely on the spurious correlation between the presence of negation words (e.g., 'not') and 'contradiction' labels.
